title: 2025 HMMT February Guts Problem 27
statement:
Compute the number of ordered pairs \((m, n)\) of odd positive integers both less than 80 such that

\[\gcd (4^{m} + 2^{m} + 1,4^{n} + 2^{n} + 1) > 1.\]

solutions.text:
